title: Clean-label smoothies with apple and carrot pomaces: rheology and antioxidant stability
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00894H, Paper

Saeed Salari, Pedro Coelho, Joana Ferreira, Ana Lima, Isabel Sousa
Smoothies were developed from food industry side streams (whey, apple and carrot pomace). Carrot pomace induced a semi-solid, shear-thinning structure. The rice beverage retained higher TPC and antioxidant activity after in vitro digestion than whey.
